summary: The account03/B16 r36 suggestion that two physical hubs chosen away from a near-coloop h can avoid the small factor 1-||r_h||^2 by placing h inside the opposite bank J is false as a uniform disjoint grouped-crossing mechanism. The exact grouped Pluecker/Schur factorization proves S_B^2 Z_ell=(det Lambda)^2 V_{k,ell}(H,I)V_3(J), and for any pairwise disjoint H,I,J with k+ell=3 one of the two Pluecker masses consists entirely of triples avoiding h. Their total mass is exactly epsilon=1-||r_h||^2, hence V_{k,ell}(H,I)V_3(J)<=epsilon. A seven-row Parseval frame attains order epsilon while all projected-crossing row marginals equal 1/2. This refutes only the proposed two-hub Pluecker escape, not QFORM and not the r36 factorization/density receiver.
replacement_mechanism: QFORM-OVERLAP-AWARE-PUNCTURED-HUB-STABILITY-v1: couple the exact-coloop fresh-hub receiver to the nonzero slope-dominant puncture before taking absolute values, preserving overlapping original leaf sources instead of splitting the three rank directions into disjoint full-volume factors.
